title: fix: cache finished KPI weeks for a week
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The internal KPI dashboard now caches weekly Tinybird pipe results for seven days starting one day after a week ends, allowing late events to land. The current and just-ended weeks retain their 30-minute cache. Cold loads are expected to drop from about 97 Tinybird calls and 105 seconds to 13 calls and 15 seconds; weekly reads are expected to fall by roughly 4.4 TB. Retention queries remain the largest cost at about 10 GB and 9 seconds per load. Traffic-classification changes now require a TINYBIRD_CACHE_VERSION bump, and a test covers the Monday boundary.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a warm cream background.
